	c2.label = "Mysterious secret (hidden)"
	c2.next_id = &"secret"
	c2.condition_flag = &"knows_secret"

	var c3 := DialogChoice.new()
	c3.label = "Goodbye"
	c3.next_id = &"end"

	# DialogNodes
	var n1 := DialogNode.new()
	n1.id = &"start"
	n1.speaker = "Guard"

	n1.choices = [c1, c2, c3]

	var n2 := DialogNode.new()
	n2.id = &"quest_info"
	n2.speaker = "Guard"
	n2.text = "There's a monster in the woods."

	var n3 := DialogNode.new()
	n3.id = &"ask_again"
	n3.speaker = "Guard"
	n3.text = "Need anything else?"

	var n4 := DialogNode.new()
	n4.id = &"secret"
	n4.speaker = "Guard"
	n4.text = "I didn't steal that apple, I swear!"
	n4.next_id = &"end"

	var n5 := DialogNode.new()
	n5.id = &"end"
	n5.speaker = "Guard"
	n5.text = "Goodbye then."

	var tree := DialogTree.new()

func _create_ui_scene():

	root.name = "DialogUI"

	var speaker := Label.new()
	speaker.name = "SpeakerLabel"

	speaker.owner = root

	var rtl := RichTextLabel.new()
	rtl.name = "TextLabel"
	rtl.text = "Body text"
	root.add_child(rtl)
	rtl.owner = root

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.name = "ChoicesContainer"
	root.add_child(vbox)
	vbox.owner = root

	var scene := PackedScene.new()
	scene.pack(root)
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, "res://scenes/DialogUI.tscn")
